text: Ever wondered how a cloud is made? It takes just four steps.
Step one. The sun warms water in seas, lakes and puddles.
Some of it turns into invisible water vapour, and rises with the warm air.
As the air climbs, it spreads out and cools.
Nearly ten degrees for every kilometre.
Cool air can’t hold as much vapour.
It clings to specks of dust and salt, and becomes tiny droplets.
Billions of droplets, side by side. That’s a cloud.
And when the droplets grow too heavy… they fall as rain.
